common.tagline: Your AI mentor for realistic, end-to-end product design practice.
common.notFoundBody: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist or was deleted.
common.errorBody: This page could not be loaded. Your saved work is not affected.

nav.tagline: Your AI mentor for realistic, end-to-end product design practice.

dashboard.subtitle: Pick up where you left off, or start a new design challenge.
dashboard.demoTitle: Demo mode: no AI provider configured
dashboard.demoBody: Briefs and reviews come from the offline demo engine. Demo reviews only check that deliverables are present — they are clearly labelled and are not AI evaluations.
dashboard.emptyBody: Generate a realistic brief, then work through eight guided stages from discovery to handoff with evidence-based feedback at each step.
dashboard.reviewFailed: Review failed for {stage} — open to retry
dashboard.openTasks: {count, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
dashboard.noLearning: Feedback themes will appear after your first review.
dashboard.includesDemo: Includes {count, plural, one {# demo review} other {# demo reviews}}.

projects.title: My projects
projects.subtitle: All your practice projects, their stage and progress.
projects.emptyBody: Generate a brief to begin, or load a sample project to explore.
projects.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the brief, every submission, uploaded file and review. Export or back up first if you may need it.
projects.typeTitle: Type the project title to confirm: {title}

generator.title: Generate a project
generator.subtitle: Get a realistic brief with clear goals, constraints and 2–4 focus features. You can review and edit it before starting.
generator.chooseMode: Choose how to create the project
generator.randomBody: Let the coach propose a distinctive idea. Optionally set difficulty, platform or industry.
generator.customBody: Describe your own concept, audience, market and features. Partial information is fine.
generator.randomHint: Everything here is optional — sensible defaults are used.
generator.customHint: Fill in what you know. Empty fields are chosen for you.
generator.industryHint: Pick a suggestion or type your own.
generator.languageHint: Brief and feedback are written in this language.
generator.focusFeaturesHint: Select 2–4 ({count} selected), or none to let the coach choose.
generator.portfolioHint: What you want this project to demonstrate, e.g. “complex data tables”.
generator.featureCountError: Choose at least 2 focus features, or clear the selection to let the coach choose.
generator.invalidInputs: Some fields are too long. Shorten them and try again.
generator.generatingHint: This usually takes under a minute with an AI provider. You can leave this page; nothing is lost if you cancel.
generator.failed: The brief could not be generated.
generator.mockTitle: Sample brief from the offline generator
generator.mockBody: No AI provider is configured, so this brief was assembled from a curated list of practice ideas. It is fictional practice material.
generator.aiBody: This is a fictional practice brief. Review it carefully — edit anything that doesn’t fit before you start.
generator.notTailored: The workflow could not be tailored to this brief, so the standard eight-stage requirements are used. You can re-tailor later from the Brief page.
generator.demoBody: Without an AI provider, briefs come from a curated set of sample ideas. Add an API key in Settings for generated briefs.

brief.title: Title
brief.languageHint: Changing the language affects future feedback, not existing reviews.
brief.assumptionsNote: Assumptions are unvalidated until your research supports them.
brief.whyThisChallenge: Why this is a useful challenge
brief.challengeRationale: Why this is a useful challenge
brief.fictionNotice: This is a fictional practice brief. It does not describe a real company or a validated market opportunity.

briefPage.title: Project brief
briefPage.affectedStages: Stages with existing work that rely on these fields
briefPage.affectedHint: Selected stages will need a new passing review before they count as complete. Nothing is deleted.
briefPage.noAffected: No stage with existing work relies on these fields.
briefPage.nothingDeleted: Earlier brief versions, submissions and reviews are kept.
briefPage.savedBody: Re-tailor the workflow if the change affects stage-specific guidance. Canonical requirements stay the same.
briefPage.retailorFailed: The workflow could not be re-tailored.

project.practiceModeHint: Open any stage without passing earlier ones. Stages still only pass with a passing review.

overview.deliverablesCount: {count, plural, one {# required deliverable} other {# required deliverables}}
overview.progressNote: Progress counts completed stages only; quality is shown in each review.

next.start_project: This project is a draft. Review the brief, then start the project from the header.
next.await_review: Your Stage {n} submission is being reviewed.
next.address_revisions: Stage {n} needs revisions. Work through the revision tasks and resubmit.
next.complete_stage: Stage {n} passed review. Complete it to unlock the next stage.
next.revalidate_stage: Stage {n}: {stage} needs revalidation after a brief change.
next.write_case_study: All stages are complete. Turn the project into a case study.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.subtitle: Eight stages from discovery to handoff. Each stage unlocks when the previous one passes review and is completed.
workflow.subtitlePractice: Practice mode is on: you can work on any stage. Stages still need a passing review to be completed.
workflow.versions: {count, plural, =0 {no versions} one {# version} other {# versions}}

workspace.lockedBody: Complete the previous stage first. You can read everything here, or turn on practice mode to work ahead.
workspace.revalidationBody: Upstream changes may have invalidated this work ({reason}). Submit a revised version and pass review again.
workspace.deliverablesHint: Status reflects the latest formal review.
workspace.templateNote: A starting structure. Replace every placeholder with your own work.
workspace.draftSaved: Draft saved {date} · {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
workspace.completionHint: Requires a passing review of the latest version (score ≥ {threshold}, all mandatory deliverables, no critical issues) and the required checklist tasks.
workspace.completedBody: You can still revisit and resubmit. A new version reopens the stage until it passes again.

blocker.no_review: No formal review yet — submit your work for review.
blocker.review_outdated: The latest version hasn’t been reviewed yet.
blocker.missing_deliverables: {count, plural, one {# mandatory deliverable is} other {# mandatory deliverables are}} missing.
blocker.open_critical_tasks: {count, plural, one {# critical revision task is} other {# critical revision tasks are}} still open.
blocker.mandatory_tasks_incomplete: {count, plural, one {# required checklist task is} other {# required checklist tasks are}} not done.

workspace.noFeedback: No reviews yet. Submit your work to get evidence-based feedback.
workspace.criteriaLegend: * mandatory. Percentages are weights; scores come from the latest review.
workspace.revisitNote: Changes to completed stages may affect later stages; you’ll be told which.
workspace.reviewRunningBody: Your submission is saved. This page updates when the review is ready.
workspace.reviewFailedBody: The review could not be completed.

mentor.title: Ask the mentor
mentor.note: Guidance only — questions never change your official score.
mentor.empty: Ask about the criteria, methods or your feedback.

submission.intro: Combine written work, screenshots, PDFs and Figma links. Drafts save automatically; nothing is reviewed until you submit.
submission.lockedBody: Complete the previous stage or enable practice mode to submit work here.
submission.restoreTitle: Unsaved text found on this device
submission.restoreBody: Text that was not saved to the app was kept in this browser. Restore it?
submission.heading: Heading
submission.textPlaceholder: Write in Markdown. Use headings for each deliverable so the reviewer can cite them.
submission.markdownHelp: Markdown supported. Use one heading per deliverable.
submission.saveFailed: Couldn’t save — kept on this device
submission.attachmentsHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF up to {max} MB each.
submission.typeRejected: {name}: unsupported type. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF.
submission.tooMany: A submission can have up to {max} files.
submission.processingFailed: {name} could not be processed — see details below.
submission.pdfNoText: No text layer found (likely scanned). Only a vision-capable reviewer can read it; OCR is not available.
submission.pdfPartialText: Some pages have no extractable text.

figmaAccess.not_configured: Link saved. The reviewer can’t open Figma links without a Figma token — also attach screenshots or a PDF export.
figmaAccess.granted: File structure read via the Figma API.
figmaAccess.denied: Figma denied access with your token. Attach screenshots or a PDF export.
figmaAccess.not_found: Figma couldn’t find this file. Check the link, or attach screenshots.
figmaAccess.rate_limited: Figma rate limit reached. Attach screenshots or try again later.
figmaAccess.unsupported: This Figma file type can’t be read via the API. Attach screenshots or a PDF export.
figmaAccess.error: Figma couldn’t be reached. Attach screenshots or a PDF export.

submission.figmaHelp: Design, file, prototype or board links. A link alone is not proof that a prototype works.
submission.notesHint: Explain your reasoning, assumptions and anything the reviewer should know.
submission.waitProcessing: Wait for files to finish processing.
submission.fixFailed: {count, plural, one {# file failed} other {# files failed}} — retry or remove before submitting.
submission.addSomething: Add written work, a file or a link to submit.
submission.submitNote: Submitting locks this version. You can always submit a new one.
submission.deliverablesChecklistHint: Make sure each is clearly present.
submission.confirmBody: The version is locked and a formal review starts immediately.
submission.mockReviewBody: No AI provider is configured. The offline demo reviewer only checks whether deliverables are present and how much was written. It is not an AI evaluation.
submission.estimateNote: A rough estimate. Actual usage is recorded with the review.
submission.limitationsTitle: The reviewer won’t be able to see everything

lim.truncated: {ref}: text is long and will be truncated.
lim.textOnly: {ref}: only extracted text is sent (visuals not reviewed).

reason.provider_has_no_vision: the current provider can’t view images
reason.image_too_large: image is too large to send
reason.image_only_pdf_no_ocr: scanned PDF without text; OCR not available
reason.figma_not_configured: Figma link can’t be opened (no token)

submission.reopenBody: Submitting reopens the stage until the new version passes review. Later stages may need revalidation.
submission.discardBody: The draft text and its newly uploaded files are deleted. Submitted versions are not affected.
submission.startFromBody: Copy the text, notes and files of an earlier version into a new draft, then make your changes. Or start blank below.

review.mockTitle: Demo review — not an AI evaluation
review.mockBody: Produced by the offline demo reviewer, which only checks that deliverables are present and how much was written. It cannot judge design quality or see images.

reason.score_below_threshold: Overall score is below the pass mark ({detail}).
reason.low_confidence: Too little of the work could be evaluated (confidence {detail}%).
reason.insufficient_evaluable_weight: Less than half of the rubric could be evaluated.
reason.all_requirements_met: Score meets the pass mark, all mandatory deliverables are present and there are no critical issues.

review.confidenceNote: Confidence measures how much of the required work could be evaluated, not how good it is. The score is calculated by the app from criterion scores and fixed weights.
review.criteriaHint: Scores use the stage’s fixed weights. * marks mandatory criteria.

adj.reviewer_returned_no_result: No result returned for this criterion.
adj.visual_evidence_unavailable: Visual evidence couldn’t be accessed, so this wasn’t scored.
adj.visual_evidence_not_supplied: Needs visual evidence; none was supplied.
adj.evidence_references_invalid: Cited evidence couldn’t be verified, so credit was reduced.
adj.capped: Score capped because the status is “{status}”.

review.limitationsHint: What the reviewer could not see or verify.

lim.removedRefs: {count, plural, one {# evidence reference} other {# evidence references}} could not be verified and were removed.

reason.image_only_pdf_no_ocr: scanned PDF without text; OCR not available

review.revisionTasksHint: Mark tasks done or dismiss them with a reason. Only a new submitted version changes the score.
review.reasonMissingDeliverable: This mandatory deliverable was not found in the submission.

reviewsList.title: Reviews
reviewsList.subtitle: Every formal review is kept, newest first.
reviewsList.emptyBody: Submit work in a stage to receive your first review.

deliverablesPage.title: Deliverables
deliverablesPage.subtitle: Required deliverables per stage, their status from the latest review, and the latest submitted files.

caseStudy.title: Case study
caseStudy.subtitle: Draft an honest portfolio case study from your saved work. Sections without evidence are marked as missing — nothing is invented.
caseStudy.lockedTitle: Case study unlocks as you progress
caseStudy.lockedBody: Complete at least {required} stages to draft a case study ({completed} completed so far).
caseStudy.draftingBody: Only your submissions, reviews and brief are used.
caseStudy.draftFailed: The case study could not be drafted.
caseStudy.mockNote: This draft was assembled from your own submitted text by the offline demo engine — rewrite it in your own voice.
caseStudy.howBody: The draft is built from your brief, the latest submitted version of each stage and its review. You can edit everything before exporting.
caseStudy.regenerateBody: Regenerating replaces the current text, including your edits. Export it first if you want to keep it.
caseStudy.coverageHint: Sections are only written when you have submitted work for them.

progress.title: Learning progress
progress.subtitle: How far you’ve come and where to focus — calculated only from your saved reviews.
progress.emptyBody: Create a project and submit work to see your progress.
progress.demoIncluded: Includes {count, plural, one {# demo review} other {# demo reviews}} from the offline reviewer.
progress.demoExcluded: {count, plural, one {# demo review is} other {# demo reviews are}} excluded.
progress.skillsHint: Average criterion scores from the latest review of each stage.
progress.themesHint: How often each theme appears in revision tasks.
progress.progressVsQuality: Progress counts completed stages. Quality comes from review scores — completing tasks doesn’t mean the work meets the criteria.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, appearance, AI provider, review preferences and your local data.
settings.languageHint: Project content stays in its original language.
settings.aiHint: Keys stay on this computer and are only used by the app’s server. They are never sent to the browser.

mockReason.env_forced: AI_PROVIDER=mock is set in the environment.
mockReason.selected: You chose the offline demo provider.
mockReason.auto_no_key: No API key is configured. Add one below to enable AI generation and reviews.
mockReason.selected_but_no_key: Anthropic is selected but no API key is configured.

settings.realActiveBody: Generation, reviews and the mentor use your API key. Usage is billed to your Anthropic account.
settings.providerAuto: Automatic (Anthropic when a key is set)
settings.providerForced: Set by the AI_PROVIDER environment variable.
settings.effortHint: Higher effort is more thorough and costs more.
settings.anthropicKeyHint: Starts with sk-ant-. Stored in a private file in your data directory.
settings.figmaTokenHint: Optional, read-only. Lets the reviewer read file structure and render frames you have access to.
settings.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace
settings.envManaged: Managed by an environment variable. Change it there and restart the app.
settings.secretStorage: Keys are never stored in the database or shown in full. Environment variables take precedence.
settings.strictnessHint: Changes tone and, when demanding, raises the pass mark by 5. Required criteria never change.
settings.defaultPractice: Start new projects in practice mode
settings.defaultPracticeHint: Lets you open any stage. Stages still need a passing review.
settings.localBody: Projects, files and reviews are kept in a local folder. They are not backed up or synced across devices automatically — create backups regularly.
settings.dataDirHint: Change the location with the APP_DATA_DIR environment variable (see README).
settings.backupBody: Creates a zip with all records and uploaded files in the backups folder. API keys are not included.
settings.restoreBody: Replaces all current data with a backup. A safety backup of the current data is created first.
settings.restoreFailed: The backup could not be restored.
settings.sampleBody: Explore the app with a clearly labelled sample project.
settings.samplesRemoved: {count, plural, one {# sample project removed} other {# sample projects removed}}.
settings.dangerBody: Deletes every project, submission, uploaded file, review and setting. Backups and API keys are kept.
settings.clearBody: This cannot be undone. Create a backup first if you might need anything.
